Alif Laam Meem
Yeh woh kitaab hai jis mein kisi tarah ke shak o shubhe ki gunjaaish nahin hai. Yeh saahibaan-e-taqwa aur parhezgaar logon ke liye mujassam hidaayat hai
Jo ghaib par imaan rakhte hain, paabandi se poore ehtimaam ke saath namaaz ada karte hain, aur jo kuch hum ne rizq diya hai us mein se hamaari raah mein kharch bhi karte hain
Woh un tamaam baaton par bhi imaan rakhte hain jinhein (ae Rasool) hum ne aap par naazil kiya hai aur jo aap se pehle naazil ki gayi hain, aur aakhirat par bhi yaqeen rakhte hain
Yahi woh log hain jo apne Parwardigar ki taraf se hidaayat ke haamil hain aur falaah-yaafta aur kaamyaab hain
Ae Rasool! Jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kar liya hai un ke liye sab baraabar hai, aap inhein daraayein ya na daraayein, yeh imaan laane waale nahin hain
Khuda ne un ke dilon aur kaanon par goya mohr laga di hai ke na kuch sunte hain aur na samajhte hain, aur aankhon par bhi parde pad gaye hain. Un ke waaste aakhirat mein azaab-e-azeem hai
Kuch log aise bhi hain jo yeh kehte hain ke hum Khuda aur aakhirat par imaan laaye hain, haalaanke woh saahib-e-imaan nahin hain
Yeh Khuda aur saahibaan-e-imaan ko dhoka dena chaahte hain, haalaanke apne hi ko dhoka de rahe hain aur samajhte bhi nahin hain
Un ke dilon mein beemaari hai aur Khuda ne nifaaq ki bina par use aur bhi badha diya hai. Ab is jhoot ke nateeje mein inhein dardnaak azaab milega
Jab un se kaha jaata hai ke zameen mein fasaad na barpa karo to kehte hain ke hum to sirf islaah karne waale hain
Haalaanke yeh sab mufsid hain aur apne fasaad ko samajhte bhi nahin hain

Jab un se kaha jaata hai ke doosre momineen ki tarah imaan le aao to kehte hain ke kya hum bewaqoofon ki tarah imaan ikhtiyaar kar lein? Haalaanke asl mein yahi bewaqoof hain aur inhein is ki waaqfiyat bhi nahin hai

Jab yeh saahibaan-e-imaan se milte hain to kehte hain ke hum imaan le aaye, aur jab apne shayaateen ki khalwaton mein jaate hain to kehte hain ke hum tumhaari hi party mein hain, hum to sirf saahibaan-e-imaan ka mazaaq udaate hain
Haalaanke Khuda khud un ko mazaaq banaaye hue hai aur inhein sarkashi mein dheel diye hue hai jo inhein nazar bhi nahin aa rahi hai
Yahi woh log hain jinhon ne hidaayat ko de kar gumraahi khareed li hai, jis tijaarat se na koi faaida hai aur na us mein kisi tarah ki hidaayat hai
Un ki misaal us shakhs ki hai jis ne raushni ke liye aag bhadkaayi, aur jab har taraf raushni phail gayi to Khuda ne us ke noor ko salb kar liya, aur ab use andhere mein kuch soojhta bhi nahin hai
Yeh sab behre, goonge aur andhe ho gaye hain aur ab palat kar aane waale nahin hain

Un ki doosri misaal aasmaan ki us baarish ki hai jis mein taareeki aur garaj chamak sab kuch ho, ke maut ke khauf se kadak dekh kar kaanon mein ungliyaan rakh lein, haalaanke Khuda kaafiron ka ihaata kiye hue hai aur yeh bach kar nahin ja sakte hain

Qareeb hai ke bijli un ki aankhon ko chakaachaundh kar de, ke jab woh chamak jaaye to chal padein aur jab andhera ho jaaye to thehar jaayein. Khuda chaahe to un ki samaa'at o basaarat ko bhi khatm kar sakta hai, ke woh har shai par qudrat o ikhtiyaar rakhne waala hai
Ae insaano! Parwardigar ki ibaadat karo jis ne tumhein bhi paida kiya hai aur tum se pehle waalon ko bhi khalq kiya hai, shaayad ke tum isi tarah muttaqi aur parhezgaar ban jaao

Us Parwardigar ne tumhaare liye zameen ka farsh aur aasmaan ka shaamiyaana banaaya hai, aur phir aasmaan se paani barsa kar tumhaari rozi ke liye zameen se phal nikaale hain, lihaaza us ke liye jaan boojh kar kisi ko hamsar aur misl na banaao

Agar tumhein is kalaam ke baare mein koi shak hai jise hum ne apne bande par naazil kiya hai to is ka jaisa ek hi soorah le aao, aur Allah ke ilaawa jitne tumhaare madadgaar hain sab ko bula lo, agar tum apne da'we aur khayaal mein sachche ho
Aur agar tum aisa na kar sake aur yaqeenan na kar sakoge to us aag se daro jis ka eendhan insaan aur patthar hain aur jise kaafireen ke liye muhayya kiya gaya hai

Paighambar! Aap imaan aur amal-e-saaleh waalon ko bashaarat de dein ke un ke liye aise baaghaat hain jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hain. Inhein jab bhi wahaan koi phal diya jaaega to woh yahi kahenge ke yeh to humein pehle mil chuka hai, haalaanke woh sirf us ke mushaabeh hoga, aur un ke liye wahaan paakeeza biwiyaan bhi hongi, aur inhein us mein hamesha rehna bhi hai

Allah is baat mein koi sharm nahin mehsoos karta ke woh machchhar ya us se bhi kamtar ki misaal bayaan kare. Ab jo saahibaan-e-imaan hain woh jaante hain ke yeh sab Parwardigar ki taraf se barhaq hai, aur jinhon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya hai woh yahi kehte hain ke aakhir in misaalon se Khuda ka maqsad kya hai? Khuda isi tarah bahut se logon ko gumraahi mein chhod deta hai aur bahut son ko hidaayat de deta hai, aur gumraahi sirf unhi ka hissa hai jo faasiq hain

Jo Khuda ke saath mazboot ahd karne ke baad bhi use tod dete hain, aur jise Khuda ne jodne ka hukm diya hai use kaat dete hain, aur zameen mein fasaad barpa karte hain, yahi woh log hain jo haqeeqatan khasaare waale hain

Aakhir tum log kis tarah kufr ikhtiyaar karte ho jab ke tum be-jaan the aur Khuda ne tumhein zindagi di hai, aur phir maut bhi dega aur phir zinda bhi karega, aur phir us ki baargaah mein palta kar le jaaye jaaoge

Woh Khuda woh hai jis ne zameen ke tamaam zakheeron ko tum hi logon ke liye paida kiya hai. Us ke baad us ne aasmaan ka rukh kiya to saat mustahkam aasmaan bana diye, aur woh har shai ka jaanne waala hai

Ae Rasool! Us waqt ko yaad karo jab tumhaare Parwardigar ne malaaika se kaha ke main zameen mein apna khaleefa banaane waala hoon, aur unhon ne kaha ke kya use banaaega jo zameen mein fasaad barpa kare aur khoon-rezi kare, jab ke hum teri tasbeeh aur taqdees karte hain? To irshaad hua ke main woh jaanta hoon jo tum nahin jaante ho
Aur Khuda ne Aadam ko tamaam asmaa ki ta'leem di aur phir un sab ko malaaika ke saamne pesh kar ke farmaaya ke zara tum un sab ke naam to batao agar tum apne khayaal-e-istehqaaq mein sachche ho
Malaaika ne arz ki ke hum to utna hi jaante hain jitna tu ne bataaya hai, ke tu saahib-e-ilm bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi

Irshaad hua ke Aadam! Ab tum inhein baakhabar kar do. To jab Aadam ne baakhabar kar diya to Khuda ne farmaaya ke main ne tum se na kaha tha ke main aasmaan o zameen ke ghaib ko jaanta hoon, aur jo kuch tum zaahir karte ho ya chhupaate ho sab ko jaanta hoon
Aur yaad karo woh mauqa jab hum ne malaaika se kaha ke Aadam ke liye sajda karo, to Iblees ke ilaawa sab ne sajda kar liya. Us ne inkaar aur ghuroor se kaam liya aur kaafireen mein ho gaya

Aur hum ne kaha ke ae Aadam! Ab tum apni zauja ke saath jannat mein saakin ho jaao aur jahaan chaaho aaraam se khaao, sirf is darakht ke qareeb na jaana ke apne oopar zulm karne waalon mein se ho jaaoge

Tab Shaitaan ne inhein fareb dene ki koshish ki aur inhein un ne'maton se baahar nikaal liya, aur hum ne kaha ke ab tum sab zameen par utar jaao, wahaan ek doosre ki dushmani hogi aur wahin tumhaara markaz hoga, aur ek khaas waqt tak ke liye aish-e-zindagaani rahegi
Phir Aadam ne Parwardigar se kalimaat ki ta'leem haasil ki aur un ki barkat se Khuda ne un ki tauba qubool kar li, ke woh tauba qubool karne waala aur meharbaan hai
Aur hum ne yeh bhi kaha ke yahaan se utar pado, phir agar hamaari taraf se hidaayat aa jaaye to jo bhi us ka ittibaa' kar lega us ke liye na koi khauf hoga na huzn
Jo log kaafir ho gaye aur unhon ne hamaari nishaaniyon ko jhutla diya woh Jahannami hain aur hamesha wahin pade rahenge
Ae Bani Israaeel! Hamaari ne'maton ko yaad karo jo hum ne tum par naazil ki hain, aur hamaare ahd ko poora karo, hum tumhaare ahd ko poora karenge, aur hum se darte raho
Hum ne jo Quran tumhaari Taurait ki tasdeeq ke liye bheja hai us par imaan le aao aur sab se pehle kaafir na ban jaao. Hamaari aayaton ko ma'mooli qeemat par na becho aur hum se darte raho
Haq ko baatil se makhloot na karo aur jaan boojh kar haq ki parda-poshi na karo
Namaaz qaaim karo, zakaat ada karo aur rukoo' karne waalon ke saath rukoo' karo
Kya tum logon ko nekiyon ka hukm dete ho aur khud apne ko bhool jaate ho, jab ke kitaab-e-Khuda ki tilaawat bhi karte ho? Kya tumhaare paas aql nahin hai
Sabr aur namaaz ke zariye madad maango. Namaaz bahut mushkil kaam hai magar un logon ke liye jo khushoo' o khuzoo' waale hain
Aur jinhein yeh khayaal hai ke inhein Allah se mulaaqaat karna hai aur us ki baargaah mein waapas jaana hai
Ae Bani Israaeel! Hamaari un ne'maton ko yaad karo jo hum ne tumhein inaayat ki hain, aur hum ne tumhein aalameen se behtar banaaya hai
Us din se daro jis din koi kisi ka badal na ban sakega aur kisi ki sifaarish qubool na hogi, na koi mu'aawaza liya jaaega aur na kisi ki madad ki jaaegi

Aur jab hum ne tum ko Fir'aun waalon se bacha liya jo tumhein badtareen dukh de rahe the, tumhaare bachchon ko qatl kar rahe the aur auraton ko zinda rakhte the, aur is mein tumhaare liye bahut bada imtehaan tha
Hamaara yeh ehsaan bhi yaad karo ke hum ne darya ko shigaafta kar ke tumhein bacha liya aur Fir'aun waalon ko tumhaari nigaahon ke saamne dubo diya
Aur hum ne Moosa se chaalees raaton ka wa'da liya to tum ne un ke baad gosaala taiyaar kar liya, ke tum bade zaalim ho
Phir hum ne tumhein maaf kar diya ke shaayad shukr-guzaar ban jaao
Aur hum ne Moosa ko kitaab aur haq o baatil ko juda karne waala qaanoon diya ke shaayad tum hidaayat-yaafta ban jaao

Aur woh waqt bhi yaad karo jab Moosa ne apni qaum se kaha ke tum ne gosaala bana kar apne oopar zulm kiya hai. Ab tum Khaaliq ki baargaah mein tauba karo aur apne nafson ko qatl kar daalo ke yahi tumhaare haq mein khair hai. Phir Khuda ne tumhaari tauba qubool kar li ke woh bada tauba qubool karne waala meharbaan hai
Aur woh waqt bhi yaad karo jab tum ne Moosa se kaha ke hum us waqt tak imaan na laayenge jab tak Khuda ko e'laaniya na dekh lein, jis ke baad bijli ne tum ko le daala aur tum dekhte hi reh gaye
Phir hum ne tumhein maut ke baad zinda kar diya ke shaayad ab shukr-guzaar ban jaao
Aur hum ne tumhaare saron par abr ka saaya kiya, tum par Mann o Salwa naazil kiya ke paakeeza rizq itminaan se khaao. Un logon ne hamaara kuch nahin bigaada balke khud apne nafs par zulm kiya hai

Aur woh waqt bhi yaad karo jab hum ne kaha ke is qarye mein daakhil ho jaao aur jahaan chaaho itminaan se khaao, aur darwaaze se sajda karte hue aur Hittah kehte hue daakhil ho ke hum tumhaari khataayein maaf kar denge, aur hum nek amal waalon ki jaza mein izaafa bhi kar dete hain
Magar zaalimon ne jo baat un se kahi gayi thi use badal diya, to hum ne un zaalimon par un ki naafarmaani ki bina par aasmaan se azaab naazil kar diya

Aur us mauqe ko yaad karo jab Moosa ne apni qaum ke liye paani ka mutaalaba kiya to hum ne kaha ke apna asa patthar par maaro, jis ke nateeje mein baarah chashme jaari ho gaye aur sab ne apna apna ghaat pehchaan liya. Ab hum ne kaha ke Mann o Salwa khaao aur chashme ka paani piyo aur roo-e-zameen mein fasaad na phailaao

Aur woh waqt bhi yaad karo jab tum ne Moosa se kaha ke hum ek qism ke khaane par sabr nahin kar sakte, aap Parwardigar se dua kijiye ke hamaare liye zameen se sabzi, kakdi, lehsan, masoor aur pyaaz waghaira paida kare. Moosa ne tumhein samjhaaya ke kya behtareen ne'maton ke badle ma'mooli ne'mat lena chaahte ho? To jaao kisi shehar mein utar pado, wahaan yeh sab kuch mil jaaega. Ab un par zillat aur muhtaaji ki maar pad gayi aur woh ghazab-e-Ilaahi mein giraftaar ho gaye. Yeh sab is liye hua ke yeh log aayaat-e-Ilaahi ka inkaar karte the aur naahaq ambiya-e-Khuda ko qatl kar diya karte the, is liye ke yeh sab naafarmaan the aur zulm kiya karte the

Jo log ba-zaahir imaan laaye ya Yahoodi, Nasaara aur sitaara-parast hain, un mein se jo waaqe'i Allah aur aakhirat par imaan laaega aur nek amal karega us ke liye Parwardigar ke yahaan ajr o sawaab hai aur koi huzn o khauf nahin hai

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab hum ne tum se Taurait par amal karne ka ahd liya aur tumhaare saron par Koh-e-Toor ko latka diya ke ab Taurait ko mazbooti se pakdo aur jo kuch us mein hai use yaad rakho, shaayad is tarah parhezgaar ban jaao
Phir tum logon ne inhiraaf kiya, ke agar fazl-e-Khuda aur rehmat-e-Ilaahi shaamil-e-haal na hoti to tum khasaare waalon mein se ho jaate
Tum un logon ko bhi jaante ho jinhon ne Shamba ke mu'aamale mein ziyaadati se kaam liya, to hum ne hukm de diya ke ab zillat ke saath bandar ban jaayein
Aur hum ne is jinsi tabdeeli ko dekhne waalon aur baad waalon ke liye ibrat aur saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye naseehat bana diya

Aur woh mauqa bhi yaad karo jab Moosa ne qaum se kaha ke Khuda ka hukm hai ke ek gaaye zibah karo, to un logon ne kaha ke aap humein mazaaq bana rahe hain? Farmaaya panaah ba-Khuda ke main jaahilon mein se ho jaaoon
Un logon ne kaha ke achchha Khuda se dua kijiye ke humein us ki haqeeqat bataaye. Unhon ne kaha ke aisi gaaye chaahiye jo na boodhi ho na bachcha, darmiyaani qism ki ho. Ab hukm-e-Khuda par amal karo
Un logon ne kaha yeh bhi poochhiye ke rang kya hoga? Kaha ke hukm-e-Khuda hai ke zard bhadak-daar rang ki ho jo dekhne mein bhali maaloom ho
Un logon ne kaha ke aisi to bahut si gaayein hain, ab kaun si zibah karein, use bayaan kiya jaaye, hum Insha'Allah talaash kar lenge

Hukm hua ke aisi gaaye jo kaarobaari na ho, na zameen jote na khet seenche, aisi saaf suthri ke us mein koi dhabba bhi na ho. Un logon ne kaha ke ab aap ne theek bayaan kiya hai. Us ke baad un logon ne zibah kar diya, haalaanke woh aisa karne waale nahin the
Aur jab tum ne ek shakhs ko qatl kar diya aur us ke qaatil ke baare mein jhagda karne lage, jab ke Khuda us raaz ka waazeh karne waala hai jise tum chhupa rahe the
To hum ne kaha ke maqtool ko gaaye ke tukde se mas kar do. Khuda isi tarah murdon ko zinda karta hai aur tumhein apni nishaaniyaan dikhlaata hai ke shaayad tumhein aql aa jaaye

Phir tumhaare dil sakht ho gaye jaise patthar ya us se bhi kuch ziyaada sakht, ke pattharon mein se to ba'z se nahrein bhi jaari ho jaati hain, aur ba'z shigaafta ho jaate hain to un se paani nikal aata hai, aur ba'z khauf-e-Khuda se gir padte hain. Lekin Allah tumhaare aamaal se ghaafil nahin hai

Musalmaano! Kya tumhein ummeed hai ke yeh Yahoodi tumhaari tarah imaan le aayenge, jab ke un ke aslaaf ka ek giroh kalaam-e-Khuda ko sun kar tahreef kar deta tha, haalaanke sab samajhte bhi the aur jaante bhi the

Yeh Yahoodi imaan waalon se milte hain to kehte hain ke hum bhi imaan le aaye, aur aapas mein ek doosre se milte hain to kehte hain ke kya tum Musalmaanon ko Taurait ke mataalib bata doge ke woh apne Nabi ke ausaaf se tumhaare oopar istidlaal karein? Kya tumhein aql nahin hai ke aisi hamaaqat karoge
Kya tumhein nahin maaloom ke Khuda sab kuch jaanta hai jis ka yeh izhaar kar rahe hain aur jis ki yeh parda-poshi kar rahe hain
Un Yahoodiyon mein kuch aise jaahil bhi hain jo Taurait ko yaad kiye hue hain aur us ke baare mein siwaaye ummeedon ke kuch nahin jaante hain, haalaanke yeh un ka faqat khayaal-e-khaam hai

Waaye ho un logon par jo apne haath se kitaab likh kar yeh kehte hain ke yeh Khuda ki taraf se hai taake use thode daam mein bech lein. Un ke liye is tahreer par bhi azaab hai aur is ki kamaai par bhi

Yeh kehte hain ke humein aatish-e-Jahannam chand din ke ilaawa chhoo bhi nahin sakti. Un se poochhiye ke kya tum ne Allah se koi ahd le liya hai jis ki woh mukhaalifat nahin kar sakta, ya us ke khilaaf jahaalat ki baatein kar rahe ho
Yaqeenan jis ne koi buraai haasil ki aur us ki ghalati ne use gher liya woh log ahl-e-Jahannam hain aur wahin hamesha rehne waale hain
Aur jo imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek amal kiye woh ahl-e-jannat hain aur wahin hamesha rehne waale hain

Us waqt ko yaad karo jab hum ne Bani Israaeel se ahd liya ke khabardaar Khuda ke ilaawa kisi ki ibaadat na karna, aur maa baap, qaraabatdaaron, yateemon aur miskeenon ke saath achchha bartaao karna, logon se achchhi baatein karna, namaaz qaaim karna, zakaat ada karna. Lekin us ke baad tum mein se chand ke ilaawa sab munharif ho gaye, aur tum log to bas e'raaz karne waale hi ho
Aur hum ne tum se ahd liya ke aapas mein ek doosre ka khoon na bahaana aur kisi ko apne watan se nikaal baahar na karna, aur tum ne us ka iqraar kiya aur tum khud hi us ke gawaah bhi ho

Lekin us ke baad tum ne qatl o khoon shuroo kar diya, logon ko ilaaqe se baahar nikaalne lage aur gunaah o ta'addi mein zaalimon ki madad karne lage, haalaanke koi qaidi ban kar aata hai to fidya de kar aazaad bhi kara lete ho, jab ke shuroo se un ka nikaalna hi haraam tha. Kya tum kitaab ke ek hisse par imaan rakhte ho aur ek ka inkaar kar dete ho? Aisa karne waalon ki kya saza hai siwaaye is ke ke zindagaani-e-duniya mein zaleel hon, aur qiyaamat ke din sakht-tareen azaab ki taraf palta diye jaayenge, aur Allah tumhaare kartoot se bekhabar nahin hai
Yeh woh log hain jinhon ne aakhirat ko de kar duniya khareed li hai, ab na un ke azaab mein takhfeef hogi aur na un ki madad ki jaaegi

Hum ne Moosa ko kitaab di, un ke peechhe rasoolon ka silsila qaaim kiya, Eesa ibn-e-Maryam ko waazeh mo'jizaat ata kiye, Rooh-ul-Qudus se un ki taaeed kara di. Lekin kya tumhaara mustaqil tareeqa yahi hai ke jab koi rasool tumhaari khwaahish ke khilaaf koi paighaam le kar aata hai to akad jaate ho, aur ek jamaa'at ko jhutla dete ho aur ek ko qatl kar dete ho
Aur yeh log kehte hain ke hamaare dilon par parde pade hue hain, hamaari kuch samajh mein nahin aata. Beshak un ke kufr ki bina par un par Khuda ki maar hai, aur yeh bahut kam imaan le aayenge

Aur jab un ke paas Khuda ki taraf se kitaab aayi hai jo un ki Taurait waghaira ki tasdeeq bhi karne waali hai, aur is se pehle woh dushmanon ke muqaable mein isi ke zariye talab-e-fatah bhi karte the, lekin is ke aate hi munkir ho gaye haalaanke use pehchaante bhi the, to ab kaafiron par Khuda ki la'nat hai

Un logon ne apne nafs ka kitna bura sauda kiya hai ke zabardasti Khuda ke naazil kiye ka inkaar kar baithe, is zid mein ke Khuda apne fazl o karam se apne jis bande par jo chaahe naazil kar deta hai. Ab yeh ghazab baalaa-e-ghazab ke haqdaar hain aur un ke liye ruswa-kun azaab bhi hai

Jab un se kaha jaata hai ke Khuda ke naazil kiye hue par imaan le aao to kehte hain ke hum sirf us par imaan le aayenge jo hum par naazil hua hai, aur us ke ilaawa sab ka inkaar kar dete hain, agarche woh bhi haq hai aur un ke paas jo kuch hai us ki tasdeeq karne waala bhi hai. Ab aap un se kahiye ke agar tum momin ho to is se pehle ambiya-e-Khuda ko qatl kyon karte the
Yaqeenan Moosa tumhaare paas waazeh nishaaniyaan le kar aaye, lekin tum ne un ke baad gosaale ko ikhtiyaar kar liya aur tum waaqe'i zaalim ho

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab hum ne tum se Taurait par amal karne ka ahd liya aur tumhaare saron par Koh-e-Toor ko mu'allaq kar diya ke Taurait ko mazbooti se pakad lo, to unhon ne dar ke maare fauran iqraar kar liya ke hum ne sun to liya lekin phir naafarmaani bhi karenge, ke un ke dilon mein gosaale ki mohabbat ghol kar pila di gayi hai. Paighambar! Un se keh do ke agar tum imaandaar ho to tumhaara imaan bahut bure ahkaam deta hai
Un se kaho ke agar saare insaanon mein daar-e-aakhirat faqat tumhaare liye hai aur tum apne da'we mein sachche ho to maut ki tamanna karo
Aur yeh apne pichhle aamaal ki bina par hargiz maut ki tamanna nahin karenge, ke Khuda zaalimon ke haalaat se khoob waaqif hai

Ae Rasool! Aap dekhenge ke yeh zindagi ke sab se ziyaada harees hain, aur ba'z mushrikeen to yeh chaahte hain ke inhein hazaar baras ki umr de di jaaye, jab ke yeh hazaar baras bhi zinda rahein to tool-e-hayaat inhein azaab-e-Ilaahi se nahin bacha sakta. Allah un ke aamaal ko khoob dekh raha hai

Ae Rasool! Keh dijiye ke jo shakhs bhi Jibreel ka dushman hai use maaloom hona chaahiye ke Jibreel ne aap ke dil par Quran hukm-e-Khuda se utaara hai, jo saabiq kitaabon ki tasdeeq karne waala, hidaayat aur saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye bashaarat hai
Jo bhi Allah, malaaika, mursaleen aur Jibreel o Meekaaeel ka dushman hoga use maaloom rahe ke Khuda bhi tamaam kaafiron ka dushman hai
Hum ne aap ki taraf raushan nishaaniyaan naazil ki hain, aur un ka inkaar faasiqon ke siwa koi na karega
Un ka haal yeh hai ke jab bhi unhon ne koi ahd kiya to ek fareeq ne zaroor tod diya, balke un ki aksariyat be-imaan hi hai
Aur jab un ke paas Khuda ki taraf se saabiq ki kitaabon ki tasdeeq karne waala Rasool aaya to ahl-e-kitaab ki ek jamaa'at ne kitaab-e-Khuda ko pas-e-pusht daal diya jaise woh use jaante hi na hon

Aur un baaton ka ittibaa' shuroo kar diya jo shayaateen Sulaimaan ki saltanat mein japa karte the, haalaanke Sulaimaan kaafir nahin the. Kaafir yeh shayaateen the jo logon ko jaadu ki ta'leem dete the, aur phir jo kuch do farishton Haaroot Maaroot par Baabil mein naazil hua hai. Woh us ki bhi ta'leem us waqt tak nahin dete the jab tak yeh keh nahin dete the ke hum zariya-e-imtehaan hain, khabardaar tum kaafir na ho jaana. Lekin woh log un se woh baatein seekhte the jis se miyaan biwi ke darmiyaan jhagda kara dein, haalaanke izn-e-Khuda ke baghair woh kisi ko nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakte. Yeh un se woh sab kuch seekhte the jo un ke liye muzir tha aur us ka koi faaida nahin tha. Yeh khoob jaante the ke jo bhi in cheezon ko khareedega us ka aakhirat mein koi hissa na hoga. Unhon ne apne nafs ka bahut bura sauda kiya hai, agar yeh kuch jaante aur samajhte hon
Agar yeh log imaan le aate aur muttaqi ban jaate to Khudaai sawaab bahut behtar tha, agar un ki samajh mein aa jaata
Imaan waalo! Raa'ina (hamaari ri'aayat karo) na kaha karo, Unzurna kaha karo aur ghaur se suna karo, aur yaad rakho ke kaafireen ke liye bada dardnaak azaab hai

Kaafir ahl-e-kitaab Yahood o Nasaara aur aam mushrikeen yeh nahin chaahte ke tumhaare oopar Parwardigar ki taraf se koi khair naazil ho, haalaanke Allah jise chaahta hai apni rehmat ke liye makhsoos kar leta hai, aur Allah bade fazl o karam ka maalik hai

Aur ae Rasool! Hum jab bhi kisi aayat ko mansookh karte hain ya dilon se mahw kar dete hain to us se behtar ya us ki jaisi aayat zaroor le aate hain. Kya tum nahin jaante ke Allah har shai par qaadir hai
Kya tum nahin jaante ke aasmaan o zameen ki hukoomat sirf Allah ke liye hai, aur us ke ilaawa koi sarparast hai na madadgaar

Ae logo! Kya tum yeh chaahte ho ke apne Rasool se waisa hi mutaalaba karo jaisa ke Moosa se kiya gaya tha? To yaad rakho ke jis ne imaan ko kufr se badal liya woh badtareen raaste par gumraah ho gaya hai

Bahut se ahl-e-kitaab yeh chaahte hain ke tumhein bhi imaan ke baad kaafir bana lein. Woh tum se hasad rakhte hain warna haq un par bilkul waazeh hai. To ab tum inhein maaf kar do aur un se darguzar karo yahaan tak ke Khuda apna koi hukm bhej de, aur Allah har shai par qaadir hai
Aur tum namaaz qaaim karo aur zakaat ada karo, ke jo kuch apne waaste pehle bhej doge sab Khuda ke yahaan mil jaaega. Khuda tumhaare aamaal ko khoob dekhne waala hai
Yeh Yahoodi kehte hain ke jannat mein Yahoodiyon aur Eesaaiyon ke ilaawa koi daakhil na hoga. Yeh sirf un ki ummeedein hain. Un se keh dijiye ke agar tum sachche ho to koi daleel le aao
Nahin, jo shakhs apna rukh Khuda ki taraf kar dega aur nek amal karega us ke liye Parwardigar ke yahaan ajr hai, aur na koi khauf hai na huzn

Aur Yahoodi kehte hain ke Nasaara ka mazhab kuch nahin hai, aur Nasaara kehte hain ke Yahoodiyon ki koi buniyaad nahin hai, haalaanke donon hi kitaab-e-Ilaahi ki tilaawat karte hain, aur un se pehle jaahil mushrikeen-e-Arab bhi yahi kaha karte the. Khuda un sab ke darmiyaan roz-e-qiyaamat faisla karne waala hai

Aur us se badh kar zaalim kaun hoga jo masaajid-e-Khuda mein us ka naam lene se mana' kare aur un ki barbaadi ki koshish kare? Un logon ka hissa sirf yeh hai ke masaajid mein khaufzada ho kar daakhil hon, aur un ke liye duniya mein ruswaai hai aur aakhirat mein azaab-e-azeem
Aur Allah ke liye mashriq bhi hai aur maghrib bhi, lihaaza tum jis jagah bhi qible ka rukh kar loge samjho wahin Khuda maujood hai. Woh saahib-e-wus'at bhi hai aur saahib-e-ilm bhi hai
Aur Yahoodi kehte hain ke Khuda ke aulaad bhi hai, haalaanke woh paak o be-niyaaz hai. Zameen o aasmaan mein jo kuch bhi hai sab usi ka hai aur sab usi ke farmaanbardaar hain
Woh zameen o aasmaan ka moojid hai, aur jab kisi amr ka faisla kar leta hai to sirf 'Kun' kehta hai aur woh cheez ho jaati hai

Yeh jaahil mushrikeen kehte hain ke Khuda hum se kalaam kyon nahin karta aur hum par aayat kyon naazil nahin karta? Un se pehle waale bhi aisi hi jahaalat ki baatein kar chuke hain. Un sab ke dil milte julte hain, aur hum ne to ahl-e-yaqeen ke liye aayaat ko waazeh kar diya hai
Ae Paighambar! Hum ne aap ko haq ke saath bashaarat dene waala aur daraane waala bana kar bheja hai, aur aap se ahl-e-Jahannam ke baare mein koi sawaal na kiya jaaega

Yahood o Nasaara aap se us waqt tak raazi na honge jab tak aap un ki millat ki pairavi na kar lein. To aap keh dijiye ke hidaayat sirf hidaayat-e-Parwardigar hai, aur agar aap ilm ke aane ke baad un ki khwaahishaat ki pairavi karenge to phir Khuda ke azaab se bachaane waala na koi sarparast hoga na madadgaar
Aur jin logon ko hum ne Quran diya hai woh us ki baa-qaa'ida tilaawat karte hain aur unhi ka us par imaan bhi hai, aur jo us ka inkaar karega us ka shumaar khasaare waalon mein hoga
Ae Bani Israaeel! Un ne'maton ko yaad karo jo hum ne tumhein inaayat ki hain aur jin ke tufail tumhein saare aalam se behtar bana diya hai
Aur us din se daro jis din koi kisi ka fidya na ho sakega, aur na koi mu'aawaza kaam aaega, na koi sifaarish hogi aur na koi madad ki ja sakegi

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab Khuda ne chand kalimaat ke zariye Ibraheem ka imtehaan liya aur unhon ne poora kar diya, to us ne kaha ke hum tum ko logon ka Imaam aur qaaid bana rahe hain. Unhon ne arz ki ke meri zurriyat? Irshaad hua ke yeh uhda-e-Imaamat zaalimeen tak nahin jaaega

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab hum ne Khaana-e-Ka'ba ko sawaab aur amn ki jagah banaaya aur hukm de diya ke Maqaam-e-Ibraheem ko musalla banaao, aur Ibraheem o Ismaaeel se ahd liya ke hamaare ghar ko tawaaf aur e'tekaaf karne waalon aur rukoo' o sajda karne waalon ke liye paak o paakeeza banaaye rakho

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab Ibraheem ne dua ki ke Parwardigar! Is shehar ko amn ka shehar qaraar de de, aur is ke un ahl-e-shehar ko jo Allah aur aakhirat par imaan rakhte hon phalon ka rizq ata farma. Irshaad hua ke phir jo kaafir ho jaayenge inhein duniya mein thodi ne'matein de kar aakhirat mein azaab-e-Jahannam mein zabardasti dhakel diya jaaega jo badtareen anjaam hai

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab Ibraheem o Ismaaeel Khaana-e-Ka'ba ki deewaron ko buland kar rahe the aur dil mein yeh dua thi ke Parwardigar! Hamaari mehnat ko qubool farma le ke tu behtareen sunne waala aur jaanne waala hai

Parwardigar! Hum donon ko apna Musalmaan aur farmaanbardaar qaraar de de, aur hamaari aulaad mein bhi ek farmaanbardaar ummat paida kar. Humein hamaare manaasik dikhla de aur hamaari tauba qubool farma ke tu behtareen tauba qubool karne waala meharbaan hai

Parwardigar! Un ke darmiyaan ek Rasool ko mab'oos farma jo un ke saamne teri aayaton ki tilaawat kare, inhein kitaab o hikmat ki ta'leem de aur un ke nufoos ko paakeeza banaaye. Beshak tu saahib-e-izzat aur saahib-e-hikmat hai
Aur kaun hai jo millat-e-Ibraheem se e'raaz kare magar yeh ke apne hi ko bewaqoof banaaye? Aur hum ne inhein duniya mein muntakhab qaraar diya hai aur woh aakhirat mein nek-kirdaar logon mein hain
Jab un se un ke Parwardigar ne kaha ke apne ko mere hawaale kar do to unhon ne kaha ke main Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke liye saraapa tasleem hoon

Aur isi baat ki Ibraheem aur Ya'qoob ne apni aulaad ko wasiyyat ki ke ae mere farzando! Allah ne tumhaare liye deen ko muntakhab kar diya hai, ab us waqt tak duniya se na jaana jab tak waaqe'i Musalmaan na ho jaao

Kya tum us waqt maujood the jab Ya'qoob ka waqt-e-maut aaya aur unhon ne apni aulaad se poochha ke mere baad kis ki ibaadat karoge? To unhon ne kaha ke aap ke aur aap ke aaba o ajdaad Ibraheem o Ismaaeel o Is'haaq ke Parwardigar Khuda-e-Wahdahu La Shareek ki, aur hum usi ke Musalmaan aur farmaanbardaar hain
Yahoodiyo! Yeh qaum thi jo guzar gayi. Inhein woh milega jo unhon ne kamaaya aur tumhein woh milega jo tum kamaaoge, tum se un ke aamaal ke baare mein sawaal na hoga

Aur yeh Yahoodi aur Eesaai kehte hain ke tum log bhi Yahoodi aur Eesaai ho jaao taake hidaayat pa jaao. To aap keh dein ke saheeh raasta baatil se katra kar chalne waale Ibraheem ka raasta hai, ke woh mushrikeen mein nahin the

Aur Musalmaano! Tum un se kaho ke hum Allah par, aur jo us ne hamaari taraf bheja hai, aur jo Ibraheem, Ismaaeel, Is'haaq, Ya'qoob aur aulaad-e-Ya'qoob ki taraf naazil kiya hai, aur jo Moosa, Eesa aur ambiya ko Parwardigar ki taraf se diya gaya hai, un sab par imaan le aaye hain. Hum paighambaron mein tafreeq nahin karte, aur hum Khuda ke sachche Musalmaan hain

Ab agar yeh log bhi aisa hi imaan le aayenge to hidaayat-yaafta ho jaayenge, aur agar e'raaz karenge to yeh sirf inaad hoga, aur anqareeb Allah tumhein un sab ke shar se bacha lega ke woh sunne waala bhi hai aur jaanne waala bhi hai
Rang to sirf Allah ka rang hai, aur us se behtar kis ka rang ho sakta hai, aur hum sab usi ke ibaadat-guzaar hain

Ae Rasool! Keh dijiye ke kya tum hum se us Khuda ke baare mein jhagadte ho jo hamaara bhi Parwardigar hai aur tumhaara bhi? To hamaare liye hamaare aamaal hain aur tumhaare liye tumhaare aamaal, aur hum to sirf Khuda ke mukhlis bande hain

Kya tumhaara kehna yeh hai ke Ibraheem, Ismaaeel, Is'haaq, Ya'qoob aur aulaad-e-Ya'qoob Yahoodi ya Nasraani the? To ae Rasool! Keh dijiye ke kya tum Khuda se behtar jaante ho? Aur us se bada zaalim kaun hoga jis ke paas Khudaai shahaadat maujood ho aur woh phir parda-poshi kare? Aur Allah tumhaare aamaal se ghaafil nahin hai
Yeh ummat guzar chuki hai, us ka hissa woh hai jo us ne kiya hai aur tumhaara hissa woh hai jo tum karoge, aur Khuda tum se un ke aamaal ke baare mein koi sawaal nahin karega

Anqareeb ahmaq log yeh kahenge ke in Musalmaanon ko us qible se kis ne mod diya hai jis par pehle qaaim the? To ae Paighambar! Keh dijiye ke mashriq o maghrib sab Khuda ke hain, woh jise chaahta hai siraat-e-mustaqeem ki hidaayat de deta hai

Aur tahweel-e-qibla ki tarah hum ne tum ko darmiyaani ummat qaraar diya hai taake tum logon ke aamaal ke gawaah raho aur Paighambar tumhaare aamaal ke gawaah rahein. Aur hum ne pehle qible ko sirf is liye qibla banaaya tha ke hum yeh dekhein ke kaun Rasool ka ittibaa' karta hai aur kaun pichhle paaon palat jaata hai, agarche yeh qibla un logon ke ilaawa sab par giraan hai jin ki Allah ne hidaayat kar di hai, aur Khuda tumhaare imaan ko zaaya nahin karna chaahta. Woh bandon ke haal par meharbaan aur reham karne waala hai

Ae Rasool! Hum aap ki tawajjoh ko aasmaan ki taraf dekh rahe hain, to hum anqareeb aap ko us qible ki taraf mod denge jise aap pasand karte hain. Lihaaza aap apna rukh Masjid-ul-Haraam ki jehat ki taraf mod dijiye, aur jahaan bhi rahiye usi taraf rukh kijiye. Ahl-e-kitaab khoob jaante hain ke Khuda ki taraf se yahi barhaq hai, aur Allah un logon ke aamaal se ghaafil nahin hai

Agar aap un ahl-e-kitaab ke paas tamaam aayatein bhi pesh kar dein ke yeh aap ke qible ko maan lein to hargiz na maanenge, aur aap bhi un ke qible ko na maanenge, aur yeh aapas mein bhi ek doosre ke qible ko nahin maante. Aur ilm ke aa jaane ke baad agar aap un ki khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' kar lenge to aap ka shumaar zaalimon mein ho jaaega
Jin logon ko hum ne kitaab di hai woh Rasool ko bhi apni aulaad ki tarah pehchaante hain, bas un ka ek giroh hai jo haq ko deeda-o-daanista chhupa raha hai
Ae Rasool! Yeh haq aap ke Parwardigar ki taraf se hai, lihaaza aap un shak o shubha karne waalon mein na ho jaayein

Har ek ke liye ek rukh mu'ayyan hai aur woh usi ki taraf munh karta hai. Ab tum nekiyon ki taraf sabqat karo, aur tum sab jahaan bhi rahoge Khuda ek din sab ko jama kar dega ke woh har shai par qaadir hai
Paighambar! Aap jahaan se baahar niklein apna rukh Masjid-ul-Haraam ki samt hi rakhein ke yahi Parwardigar ki taraf se haq hai, aur Allah tum logon ke aamaal se ghaafil nahin hai

Aur aap jahaan se bhi niklein apna rukh Khaana-e-Ka'ba ki taraf rakhein, aur phir tum sab jahaan raho tum sab bhi apna rukh idhar hi rakho taake logon ke liye tumhaare oopar koi hujjat na reh jaaye, siwaaye un logon ke ke jo zaalim hain, to un ka khauf na karo balke Allah se daro, ke hum tum par apni ne'mat tamaam kar dena chaahte hain ke shaayad tum hidaayat-yaafta ho jaao

Jis tarah hum ne tumhaare darmiyaan tum hi mein se ek Rasool bheja hai jo tum par hamaari aayaat ki tilaawat karta hai, tumhein paak o paakeeza banaata hai aur tumhein kitaab o hikmat ki ta'leem deta hai, aur woh sab kuch bataata hai jo tum nahin jaante the
Ab tum hum ko yaad karo taake hum tumhein yaad rakhein, aur hamaara shukriya ada karo aur kufraan-e-ne'mat na karo
Imaan waalo! Sabr aur namaaz ke zariye madad maango ke Khuda sabr karne waalon ke saath hai
Aur jo log raah-e-Khuda mein qatl ho jaate hain inhein murda na kaho, balke woh zinda hain lekin tumhein un ki zindagi ka sha'oor nahin hai
Aur hum yaqeenan tumhein thode khauf, thodi bhook aur amwaal, nufoos aur samaraat ki kami se aazmaayenge, aur ae Paighambar! Aap un sabr karne waalon ko bashaarat de dein
Jo museebat padne ke baad yeh kehte hain ke hum Allah hi ke liye hain aur usi ki baargaah mein waapas jaane waale hain
Ke un ke liye Parwardigar ki taraf se salawaat aur rehmat hai, aur wahi hidaayat-yaafta hain

Beshak Safa aur Marwa donon pahaadiyaan Allah ki nishaaniyon mein hain, lihaaza jo shakhs bhi Hajj ya Umra kare us ke liye koi harj nahin hai ke un donon pahaadiyon ka chakkar lagaaye, aur jo mazeed khair karega to Khuda us ke amal ka qadardaan aur us se khoob waaqif hai

Jo log hamaare naazil kiye hue waazeh bayaanaat aur hidaayaat ko hamaare bayaan kar dene ke baad bhi chhupaate hain un par Allah bhi la'nat karta hai aur tamaam la'nat karne waale bhi la'nat karte hain

Ilaawa un logon ke jo tauba kar lein aur apne kiye ki islaah kar lein aur jis ko chhupaaya hai us ko waazeh kar dein, to hum un ki tauba qubool kar lete hain ke hum behtareen tauba qubool karne waale aur meharbaan hain
Jo log kaafir ho gaye aur usi haalat-e-kufr mein mar gaye un par Allah, malaaika aur tamaam insaanon ki la'nat hai
Woh usi la'nat mein hamesha rahenge, ke na un ke azaab mein takhfeef hogi aur na inhein mohlat di jaaegi
Aur tumhaara Khuda bas ek hai, us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, wahi Rahmaan bhi hai aur wahi Raheem bhi hai

Beshak zameen o aasmaan ki khilqat, roz o shab ki raft o aamad, un kashtiyon mein jo daryaaon mein logon ke faaide ke liye chalti hain, aur us paani mein jise Khuda ne aasmaan se naazil kar ke us ke zariye murda zameenon ko zinda kar diya hai aur us mein tarah tarah ke chaupaaye phaila diye hain, aur hawaaon ke chalaane mein, aur aasmaan o zameen ke darmiyaan musakhkhar kiye jaane waale baadal mein, saahibaan-e-aql ke liye Allah ki nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Logon mein kuch aise log bhi hain jo Allah ke ilaawa doosron ko us ka misl qaraar dete hain aur un se Allah jaisi mohabbat bhi karte hain, jab ke imaan waalon ki tamaam-tar mohabbat Khuda se hoti hai. Aur ae kaash zaalimeen is baat ko us waqt dekh lete jo azaab ko dekhne ke baad samjhenge ke saari quwwat sirf Allah ke liye hai aur Allah sakht-tareen azaab karne waala hai
Us waqt jab ke peer apne mureedon se bezaari ka izhaar karenge aur sab ke saamne azaab hoga aur tamaam wasaail munqata' ho chuke honge

Aur mureed bhi yeh kahenge ke ae kaash hum ne un se isi tarah bezaari ikhtiyaar ki hoti jis tarah yeh aaj hum se nafrat kar rahe hain. Khuda un sab ke aamaal ko isi tarah hasrat bana kar pesh karega, aur un mein se koi Jahannam se nikalne waala nahin hai
Ae insaano! Zameen mein jo kuch bhi halaal o tayyib hai use isti'maal karo aur Shaitaani iqdaamaat ka ittibaa' na karo ke woh tumhaara khula hua dushman hai
Woh bas tumhein bad-amali aur badkaari ka hukm deta hai aur is baat par aamaada karta hai ke Khuda ke khilaaf jahaalat ki baatein karte raho

Jab un se kaha jaata hai ke jo kuch Khuda ne naazil kiya hai us ka ittibaa' karo to kehte hain ke hum us ka ittibaa' karenge jis par hum ne apne baap daada ko paaya hai. Kya yeh aisa hi karenge chaahe un ke baap daada be-aql hi rahe hon aur hidaayat-yaafta na rahe hon

Jo log kaafir ho gaye hain un ke pukaarne waale ki misaal us shakhs ki hai jo jaanwaron ko aawaaz de aur jaanwar pukaar aur aawaaz ke ilaawa kuch na sunein aur na samjhein. Yeh kuffaar behre, goonge aur andhe hain, inhein aql se sarokaar nahin hai
Saahibaan-e-imaan! Jo hum ne paakeeza rizq ata kiya hai use khaao aur dene waale Khuda ka shukriya ada karo agar tum us ki ibaadat karte ho

Us ne tumhaare oopar bas murdaar, khoon, soor ka gosht aur jo ghair-e-Khuda ke naam par zibah kiya jaaye us ko haraam qaraar diya hai. Phir bhi agar koi muztar ho jaaye aur haraam ka talabgaar aur zaroorat se ziyaada isti'maal karne waala na ho to us ke liye koi gunaah nahin hai. Beshak Khuda bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Jo log Khuda ki naazil ki hui kitaab ke ahkaam ko chhupaate hain aur use thodi qeemat par bech daalte hain woh dar-haqeeqat apne pet mein sirf aag bhar rahe hain, aur Khuda roz-e-qiyaamat un se baat bhi na karega aur na inhein paakeeza qaraar dega, aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab hai
Yahi woh log hain jinhon ne gumraahi ko hidaayat ke ewaz aur azaab ko maghfirat ke ewaz khareed liya hai. Aakhir yeh aatish-e-Jahannam par kis qadr sabr karenge
Yeh azaab sirf is liye hai ke Allah ne kitaab ko haq ke saath naazil kiya hai, aur us mein ikhtilaaf karne waale haq se bahut door ho kar jhagde kar rahe hain

Neki yeh nahin hai ke apna rukh mashriq aur maghrib ki taraf kar lo, balke neki us shakhs ka hissa hai jo Allah aur aakhirat, malaaika aur kitaab aur ambiya par imaan le aaye, aur mohabbat-e-Khuda mein qaraabatdaaron, yateemon, miskeenon, ghurbat-zada musaafiron, sawaal karne waalon aur ghulaamon ki aazaadi ke liye maal de, aur namaaz qaaim kare aur zakaat ada kare, aur jo bhi ahd kare use poora kare, aur faqr o faaqe mein aur pareshaaniyon aur beemaariyon mein aur maidaan-e-jang ke haalaat mein sabr karne waale hon, to yahi log apne da'wa-e-imaan o ehsaan mein sachche hain aur yahi saahibaan-e-taqwa aur parhezgaar hain

Imaan waalo! Tumhaare oopar maqtooleen ke baare mein qisaas likh diya gaya hai: aazaad ke badle aazaad, aur ghulaam ke badle ghulaam, aur aurat ke badle aurat. Ab agar kisi ko maqtool ke waaris ki taraf se maafi mil jaaye to neki ka ittibaa' kare aur ehsaan ke saath us ke haq ko ada kar de. Yeh Parwardigar ki taraf se tumhaare haq mein takhfeef aur rehmat hai, lekin ab jo shakhs ziyaadati karega us ke liye dardnaak azaab bhi hai
Saahibaan-e-aql! Tumhaare liye qisaas mein zindagi hai ke shaayad tum is tarah muttaqi ban jaao

Tumhaare oopar yeh bhi likh diya hai ke jab tum mein se kisi ki maut saamne aa jaaye to agar koi maal chhoda hai to apne maa baap aur qaraabatdaaron ke liye wasiyyat kar de. Yeh saahibaan-e-taqwa par ek tarah ka haq hai
Us ke baad wasiyyat ko sun kar jo shakhs tabdeel kar dega us ka gunaah tabdeel karne waale par hoga, tum par nahin. Khuda sab ka sunne waala aur sab ke haalaat se baakhabar hai

Phir agar koi shakhs wasiyyat karne waale ki taraf se taraf-daari ya na-insaafi ka khauf rakhta ho aur woh warasa mein sulh kara de to us par koi gunaah nahin hai. Allah bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Saahibaan-e-imaan! Tumhaare oopar roze isi tarah likh diye gaye hain jis tarah tumhaare pehle waalon par likhe gaye the, shaayad tum isi tarah muttaqi ban jaao

Yeh roze sirf chand din ke hain, lekin us ke baad bhi koi shakhs mareez hai ya safar mein hai to utne hi din doosre zamaane mein rakh lega, aur jo log sirf shiddat aur mashaqqat ki bina par roze nahin rakh sakte hain woh ek miskeen ko khaana khila dein, aur agar apni taraf se ziyaada neki kar dein to aur behtar hai. Lekin roza rakhna bahar-haal tumhaare haq mein behtar hai agar tum saahibaan-e-ilm o khabar ho

Maah-e-Ramazaan woh maheena hai jis mein Quran naazil kiya gaya hai jo logon ke liye hidaayat hai, aur us mein hidaayat aur haq o baatil ke imtiyaaz ki waazeh nishaaniyaan maujood hain. Lihaaza jo shakhs is maheene mein haazir rahe us ka farz hai ke roza rakhe, aur jo mareez ya musaafir ho woh utne hi din doosre zamaane mein rakhe. Khuda tumhaare baare mein aasaani chaahta hai, zehmat nahin chaahta. Aur utne hi din ka hukm is liye hai ke tum adad poore kar do aur Allah Ta'ala ki di hui hidaayat par us ki kibriyaai ka iqraar karo, aur shaayad tum is tarah us ke shukr-guzaar bande ban jaao

Aur ae Paighambar! Agar mere bande tum se mere baare mein sawaal karein to main un se qareeb hoon. Pukaarne waale ki aawaaz sunta hoon jab bhi pukaarta hai, lihaaza mujh se talab-e-qabooliyat karein aur mujh hi par imaan o e'temaad rakhein ke shaayad is tarah raah-e-raast par aa jaayein

Tumhaare liye maah-e-Ramazaan ki raat mein auraton ke paas jaana halaal kar diya gaya hai. Woh tumhaare liye parda-posh hain aur tum un ke liye. Khuda ko maaloom hai ke tum apne hi nafs se khiyaanat karte the, to us ne tumhaari tauba qubool kar ke tumhein maaf kar diya. Ab tum ba-itminaan mubaasharat karo aur jo Khuda ne tumhaare liye muqaddar kiya hai us ki aarzoo karo, aur us waqt tak kha pi sakte ho jab tak fajr ka siyaah dora safed dore se numaayaan na ho jaaye. Us ke baad raat ki siyaahi tak roze ko poora karo, aur khabardaar masjidon mein e'tekaaf ke mauqe par auraton se mubaasharat na karna. Yeh sab muqarrara hudood-e-Ilaahi hain, un ke qareeb bhi na jaana. Allah is tarah apni aayaton ko logon ke liye waazeh taur par bayaan karta hai ke shaayad woh muttaqi aur parhezgaar ban jaayein

Aur khabardaar ek doosre ka maal naajaaiz tareeqe se na khaana, aur na hukkaam ke hawaale kar dena ke rishwat de kar haraam tareeqe se logon ke amwaal ko kha jaao, jab ke tum jaante ho ke yeh tumhaara maal nahin hai

Ae Paighambar! Yeh log aap se chaand ke baare mein sawaal karte hain, to farma dijiye ke yeh logon ke liye aur Hajj ke liye waqt maaloom karne ka zariya hai. Aur yeh koi neki nahin hai ke makaanaat mein pichhwaade ki taraf se aao, balke neki un ke liye hai jo parhezgaar hon, aur makaanaat mein darwaazon ki taraf se aao, aur Allah se daro shaayad tum kaamyaab ho jaao
Jo log tum se jang karte hain tum bhi un se raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad karo aur ziyaadati na karo ke Khuda ziyaadati karne waalon ko dost nahin rakhta

Aur un mushrikeen ko jahaan paao qatl kar do, aur jis tarah unhon ne tum ko aawaara-e-watan kar diya hai tum bhi inhein nikaal baahar kar do, aur fitna-pardaazi to qatl se bhi badtar hai. Aur un se Masjid-ul-Haraam ke paas us waqt tak jang na karna jab tak woh tum se jang na karein. Us ke baad jang chhed dein to tum bhi chup na baitho aur jang karo ke yahi kaafireen ki saza hai
Phir agar jang se baaz aa jaayein to Khuda bada bakhshne waala meharbaan hai

Aur un se us waqt tak jang jaari rakho jab tak saara fitna khatm na ho jaaye aur deen sirf Allah ka na reh jaaye. Phir agar woh log baaz aa jaayein to zaalimeen ke ilaawa kisi par ziyaadati jaaiz nahin hai

Shahr-e-haraam ka jawaab shahr-e-haraam hai, aur hurumaat ka bhi qisaas hai. Lihaaza jo tum par ziyaadati kare tum bhi waisa hi bartaao karo jaisi ziyaadati us ne ki hai, aur Allah se darte raho aur yeh samajh lo ke Khuda parhezgaaron hi ke saath hai
Aur raah-e-Khuda mein kharch karo aur apne nafs ko halaakat mein na daalo, nek bartaao karo ke Khuda nek amal karne waalon ke saath hai

Hajj aur Umre ko Allah ke liye tamaam karo. Ab agar giraftaar ho jaao to jo qurbaani mumkin ho woh de do, aur us waqt tak sar na mundwaao jab tak qurbaani apni manzil tak na pahunch jaaye. Ab jo tum mein se mareez hai ya us ke sar mein koi takleef hai to woh roza ya sadqa ya qurbaani de de. Phir jab itminaan ho jaaye to jis ne Umre se Hajj-e-Tamattu' ka iraada kiya hai woh mumkina qurbaani de de, aur qurbaani na mil sake to teen roze Hajj ke dauraan aur saat waapas aane ke baad rakhe ke is tarah das poore ho jaayein. Yeh Hajj-e-Tamattu' aur qurbaani un logon ke liye hai jin ke ahl Masjid-ul-Haraam ke haazir shumaar nahin hote. Aur Allah se darte raho aur yeh yaad rakho ke Khuda ka azaab bahut sakht hai

Hajj chand muqarrara maheenon mein hota hai, aur jo shakhs bhi us zamaane mein apne oopar Hajj laazim kar le use auraton se mubaasharat, gunaah aur jhagde ki ijaazat nahin hai, aur tum jo bhi khair karoge Khuda use jaanta hai. Apne liye zaad-e-raah faraaham karo ke behtareen zaad-e-raah taqwa hai, aur ae saahibaan-e-aql! Hum se daro

Tumhaare liye koi harj nahin hai ke apne Parwardigar ke fazl o karam ko talaash karo. Phir jab Arafaat se kooch karo to Mash'ar-ul-Haraam ke paas zikr-e-Khuda karo, aur is tarah zikr karo jis tarah us ne hidaayat di hai, agarche tum log us se pehle gumraahon mein se the
Phir tamaam logon ki tarah tum bhi kooch karo aur Allah se istighfaar karo ke Allah bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Phir jab saare manaasik tamaam kar lo to Khuda ko isi tarah yaad rakho jis tarah apne baap daada ko yaad karte ho balke us se bhi ziyaada. Ke ba'z log aise hain jo kehte hain ke Parwardigar! Humein duniya hi mein neki de de, aur un ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahin hai
Aur ba'z kehte hain ke Parwardigar! Humein duniya mein bhi neki ata farma aur aakhirat mein bhi, aur hum ko azaab-e-Jahannam se mahfooz farma
Yahi woh log hain jin ke liye un ki kamaai ka hissa hai, aur Khuda bahut jald hisaab karne waala hai

Aur chand mu'ayyan dinon mein zikr-e-Khuda karo. Us ke baad jo do din ke andar jaldi karega us par bhi koi gunaah nahin hai, aur jo taakheer karega us par bhi koi gunaah nahin hai basharte ke parhezgaar raha ho. Aur Allah se daro aur yeh yaad rakho ke tum sab usi ki taraf mahshoor kiye jaaoge
Insaanon mein aise log bhi hain jin ki baatein zindagaani-e-duniya mein bhali lagti hain aur woh apne dil ki baaton par Khuda ko gawaah banaate hain, haalaanke woh badtareen dushman hain
Aur jab aap ke paas se munh pherte hain to zameen mein fasaad barpa karne ki koshish karte hain aur khetiyon aur naslon ko barbaad karte hain, jab ke Khuda fasaad ko pasand nahin karta hai
Jab un se kaha jaata hai ke taqwa-e-Ilaahi ikhtiyaar karo to ghuroor gunaah ke aade aa jaata hai. Aise logon ke liye Jahannam kaafi hai jo badtareen thikaana hai
Aur logon mein woh bhi hain jo apne nafs ko marzi-e-Parwardigar ke liye bech daalte hain, aur Allah apne bandon par bada meharbaan hai
Imaan waalo! Tum sab mukammal tareeqe se Islam mein daakhil ho jaao aur Shaitaani iqdaamaat ka ittibaa' na karo ke woh tumhaara khula hua dushman hai
Phir agar khuli nishaaniyon ke aa jaane ke baad laghzish paida ho jaaye to yaad rakho ke Khuda sab par ghaalib hai aur saahib-e-hikmat hai
Yeh log is baat ka intizaar kar rahe hain ke abr ke saaye ke peechhe azaab-e-Khuda ya malaaika aa jaayein aur har amr ka faisla ho jaaye, aur saare umoor ki baazgasht to Khuda hi ki taraf hai

Zara Bani Israaeel se poochhiye ke hum ne inhein kis qadr ne'matein ata ki hain. Aur jo shakhs bhi ne'maton ke aa jaane ke baad inhein tabdeel kar dega woh yaad rakhe ke Khuda ka azaab bahut shadeed hota hai

Asl mein kaafiron ke liye zindagaani-e-duniya aaraasta kar di gayi hai aur woh saahibaan-e-imaan ka mazaaq udaate hain, haalaanke qiyaamat ke din muttaqi aur parhezgaar afraad ka darja un se kaheen ziyaada baala-tar hoga, aur Allah jis ko chaahta hai be-hisaab rizq deta hai

(Fitri e'tebaar se) saare insaan ek qaum the. Phir Allah ne bashaarat dene waale aur daraane waale ambiya bheje aur un ke saath barhaq kitaab naazil ki taake logon ke ikhtilaafaat ka faisla karein, aur asl ikhtilaaf unhi logon ne kiya jinhein kitaab mil gayi hai aur un par aayaat waazeh ho gayin, sirf baghaawat aur ta'addi ki bina par. To Khuda ne imaan waalon ko hidaayat de di aur unhon ne ikhtilaafaat mein hukm-e-Ilaahi se haq daryaaft kar liya, aur woh to jis ko chaahta hai siraat-e-mustaqeem ki hidaayat de deta hai

Kya tumhaara khayaal hai ke tum aasaani se jannat mein daakhil ho jaaoge, jab ke abhi tumhaare saamne saabiq ummaton ki misaal pesh nahin aayi jinhein faqr o faaqe aur pareshaaniyon ne gher liya aur itne jhatke diye gaye ke khud Rasool aur un ke saathiyon ne yeh kehna shuroo kar diya ke aakhir Khudaai imdaad kab aaegi? To aagaah ho jaao ke Khudaai imdaad bahut qareeb hai

Paighambar! Yeh log aap se sawaal karte hain ke raah-e-Khuda mein kya kharch karein? To aap keh dijiye ke jo bhi kharch karoge woh tumhaare waalidain, qaraabatdaar, aitaam, masaakeen aur ghurbat-zada musaafiron ke liye hoga, aur jo bhi kaar-e-khair karoge Khuda use khoob jaanta hai

Tumhaare oopar jihaad farz kiya gaya hai aur woh tumhein naagawaar hai, aur yeh mumkin hai ke jise tum bura samajhte ho woh tumhaare haq mein behtar ho, aur jise tum dost rakhte ho woh bura ho. Khuda sab ko jaanta hai aur tum nahin jaante ho

Paighambar! Yeh aap se mohtaram maheenon ke jihaad ke baare mein sawaal karte hain, to aap keh dijiye ke un mein jang karna gunaah-e-kabeera hai, aur raah-e-Khuda se rokna aur Khuda aur Masjid-ul-Haraam ki hurmat ka inkaar hai, aur ahl-e-Masjid-ul-Haraam ka wahaan se nikaal dena Khuda ki nigaah mein jang se bhi badtar gunaah hai, aur fitna to qatl se bhi bada jurm hai. Aur yeh kuffaar baraabar tum logon se jang karte rahenge yahaan tak ke un ke imkaan mein ho to tum ko tumhaare deen se palta dein. Aur jo bhi apne deen se palat jaaega aur kufr ki haalat mein mar jaaega us ke saare aamaal barbaad ho jaayenge, aur woh Jahannami hoga aur wahin hamesha rahega
Beshak jo log imaan laaye aur jinhon ne hijrat ki aur raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad kiya woh rehmat-e-Ilaahi ki ummeed rakhte hain, aur Khuda bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Yeh aap se sharaab aur jue ke baare mein sawaal karte hain, to keh dijiye ke in donon mein bahut bada gunaah hai aur bahut se faaide bhi hain, lekin in ka gunaah faaide se kaheen ziyaada bada hai. Aur yeh raah-e-Khuda mein kharch ke baare mein sawaal karte hain ke kya kharch karein? To keh dijiye ke jo bhi zaroorat se ziyaada ho. Khuda isi tarah apni aayaat ko waazeh kar ke bayaan karta hai ke shaayad tum fikr kar sako

Duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi. Aur yeh log tum se yateemon ke baare mein sawaal karte hain, to keh do ke un ke haal ki islaah behtareen baat hai, aur agar un se mil jul kar raho to yeh bhi tumhaare bhaai hain, aur Allah behtar jaanta hai ke muslih kaun hai aur mufsid kaun hai. Agar woh chaahta to tumhein museebat mein daal deta, lekin woh saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai

Khabardaar mushrik auraton se us waqt tak nikaah na karna jab tak imaan na le aayein, ke ek momin kaneez mushrik aazaad aurat se behtar hai chaahe woh tumhein kitni hi bhali maaloom ho. Aur mushrikeen ko bhi ladkiyaan na dena jab tak Musalmaan na ho jaayein, ke Musalmaan ghulaam aazaad mushrik se behtar hai chaahe woh tumhein kitna hi achchha kyon na maaloom ho. Yeh mushrikeen tumhein Jahannam ki daawat dete hain aur Khuda apne hukm se jannat aur maghfirat ki daawat deta hai, aur apni aayaton ko waazeh kar ke bayaan karta hai ke shaayad yeh log samajh sakein

Aur ae Paighambar! Yeh log tum se ayyaam-e-haiz ke baare mein sawaal karte hain, to keh do ke haiz ek aziyyat aur takleef hai, lihaaza is zamaane mein auraton se alag raho aur jab tak paak na ho jaayein un ke qareeb na jaao. Phir jab paak ho jaayein to jis tarah se Khuda ne hukm diya hai isi tarah un ke paas jaao. Ba-tahqeeq Khuda tauba karne waalon aur paakeeza rehne waalon ko dost rakhta hai

Tumhaari auratein tumhaari khetiyaan hain, lihaaza apni kheti mein jahaan chaaho daakhil ho jaao, aur apne waaste peshgi aamaal Khuda ki baargaah mein bhej do aur us se darte raho, yeh samjho ke tumhein us se mulaaqaat karna hai, aur saahibaan-e-imaan ko bashaarat de do

Khabardaar Khuda ko apni qasmon ka nishaana na banaao, ke qasmon ko neki karne, taqwa ikhtiyaar karne aur logon ke darmiyaan islaah karne mein maane' bana do. Allah sab kuch sunne aur jaanne waala hai

Khuda tumhaari laghw aur ghair-iraadi qasmon ka muaakhaza nahin karta hai, lekin jis ko tumhaare dilon ne haasil kiya hai us ka zaroor muaakhaza karega. Woh bakhshne waala bhi hai aur bardaasht karne waala bhi
Jo log apni biwiyon se tark-e-jimaa' ki qasam kha lete hain inhein chaar maheene ki mohlat hai. Us ke baad waapas aa gaye to Khuda Ghafoor o Raheem hai
Aur talaaq ka iraada karein to Khuda sun bhi raha hai aur dekh bhi raha hai

Mutallaqa auratein teen haiz tak intizaar karengi, aur inhein haq nahin hai ke jo kuch Khuda ne un ke reham mein paida kiya hai us ki parda-poshi karein, agar un ka imaan Allah aur aakhirat par hai. Aur phir un ke shauhar is muddat mein inhein waapas kar lene ke ziyaada haqdaar hain agar islaah chaahte hain. Aur auraton ke liye waise hi huqooq bhi hain jaisi zimmedaariyaan hain, aur mardon ko un par ek imtiyaaz haasil hai, aur Khuda saahib-e-izzat o hikmat hai

Talaaq do martaba di jaaegi. Us ke baad ya neki ke saath rok liya jaaega ya husn-e-sulook ke saath aazaad kar diya jaaega. Aur tumhaare liye jaaiz nahin hai ke jo kuch inhein de diya hai us mein se kuch waapas lo, magar yeh ke yeh andesha ho ke donon hudood-e-Ilaahi ko qaaim na rakh sakenge. To jab tumhein yeh khauf paida ho jaaye ke woh donon hudood-e-Ilaahi ko qaaim na rakh sakenge to donon ke liye aazaadi hai us fidye ke baare mein jo aurat mard ko de. Lekin yeh hudood-e-Ilaahiya hain, in se tajaawuz na karna, aur jo hudood-e-Ilaahi se tajaawuz karega woh zaalimeen mein shumaar hoga

Phir agar teesri martaba talaaq de di to aurat mard ke liye halaal na hogi yahaan tak ke doosra shauhar kare. Phir agar woh talaaq de de to donon ke liye koi harj nahin hai ke aapas mein mel kar lein, agar yeh khayaal hai ke hudood-e-Ilaahiya ko qaaim rakh sakenge. Yeh hudood-e-Ilaahiya hain jinhein Khuda saahibaan-e-ilm o ittilaa' ke liye waazeh taur se bayaan kar raha hai

Aur jab tum auraton ko talaaq do aur woh muddat-e-iddat ke khaatime ke qareeb pahunch jaayein to ya inhein islaah aur husn-e-mu'aasharat ke saath rok lo ya inhein husn-e-sulook ke saath aazaad kar do, aur khabardaar nuqsaan pahunchaane ki gharaz se inhein na rokna ke un par zulm karo, ke jo aisa karega woh khud apne nafs par zulm karega. Aur khabardaar aayaat-e-Ilaahi ko mazaaq na banaao, Khuda ki ne'mat ko yaad karo. Us ne kitaab o hikmat ko tumhaari naseehat ke liye naazil kiya hai, aur yaad rakho ke woh har shai ka jaanne waala hai

Aur jab tum log auraton ko talaaq do aur un ki muddat-e-iddat poori ho jaaye to khabardaar inhein shauhar karne se na rokna agar woh shauharon ke saath nek sulook par raazi ho jaayein. Is hukm ke zariye Khuda inhein naseehat karta hai jin ka imaan Allah aur roz-e-aakhirat par hai, aur in ahkaam par amal tumhaare liye baa'is-e-tazkiya bhi hai aur baa'is-e-tahaarat bhi. Allah sab kuch jaanta hai aur tum nahin jaante ho

Aur maayein apni aulaad ko do baras kaamil doodh pilaayengi, jo razaa'at ko poora karna chaahega. Is darmiyaan saahib-e-aulaad ka farz hai ke maaon ki roti aur kapde ka munaasib tareeqe se intizaam kare. Kisi shakhs ko us ki wus'at se ziyaada takleef nahin di ja sakti. Na maa ko us ki aulaad ke zariye takleef dene ka haq hai aur na baap ko us ki aulaad ke zariye. Aur waaris ki bhi zimmedaari hai ke woh isi tarah ujrat ka intizaam kare. Phir agar donon baahami razaamandi aur mashware se doodh chhudaana chaahein to koi harj nahin hai, aur agar tum apni aulaad ke liye doodh pilaane waali talaash karna chaaho to us mein bhi koi harj nahin hai, basharte ke muta'aarif tareeqe ki ujrat ada kar do. Aur Allah se daro aur yeh samjho ke woh tumhaare aamaal ko khoob dekh raha hai

Aur jo log tum mein se biwiyaan chhod kar mar jaayein un ki biwiyaan chaar maheene das din intizaar karengi. Jab yeh muddat poori ho jaaye to jo munaasib kaam apne haq mein karein us mein koi harj nahin hai. Khuda tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Tumhaare liye nikaah ke paighaam ki pesh-kash ya dil hi dil mein posheeda iraade mein koi harj nahin hai. Khuda ko maaloom hai ke tum baad mein un se tazkira karoge, lekin fil-haal khufiya wa'da bhi na lo, sirf koi nek baat keh do to koi harj nahin hai. Aur jab tak muqarrara muddat poori na ho jaaye aqd-e-nikaah ka iraada na karna. Yeh yaad rakho ke Khuda tumhaare dil ki baatein khoob jaanta hai, lihaaza us se darte raho, aur yeh jaan lo ke woh Ghafoor bhi hai aur Haleem o burdbaar bhi

Aur tum par koi zimmedaari nahin hai agar tum ne auraton ko us waqt talaaq de di jab ke un ko chhua bhi nahin hai aur un ke liye koi mehr bhi mu'ayyan nahin kiya hai. Albatta inhein kuch maal o mataa' de do, maaldaar apni haisiyat ke mutaabiq aur ghareeb apni haisiyat ke mutaabiq. Yeh mataa' ba-qadr-e-munaasib hona zaroori hai ke yeh nek-kirdaaron par ek haq hai

Aur agar tum ne un ko chhoone se pehle talaaq de di aur un ke liye mehr mu'ayyan kar chuke the to mu'ayyan mehr ka nisf dena hoga, magar yeh ke woh khud maaf kar dein ya un ka waali maaf kar de, aur maaf kar dena taqwa se ziyaada qareeb-tar hai, aur aapas mein buzurgi ko faraamosh na karo. Khuda tumhaare aamaal ko khoob dekh raha hai
Apni tamaam namaazon aur bil-khusoos namaaz-e-wusta ki muhaafazat aur paabandi karo, aur Allah ki baargaah mein khushoo' o khuzoo' ke saath khade ho jaao
Phir agar khauf ki haalat ho to paidal, sawaar jis tarah mumkin ho namaaz ada karo, aur jab itminaan ho jaaye to is tarah zikr-e-Khuda karo jis tarah us ne tumhaari la-ilmi mein tumhein bataaya hai

Aur jo log muddat-e-hayaat poori kar rahe hon aur azwaaj ko chhod kar ja rahe hon inhein chaahiye ke apni azwaaj ke liye ek saal ke kharch aur ghar se na nikaalne ki wasiyyat kar ke jaayein. Phir agar woh khud se nikal jaayein to tumhaare liye koi harj nahin hai, woh apne baare mein jo bhi munaasib kaam anjaam dein. Khuda saahib-e-izzat aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai
Aur mutallaqa auraton ko dastoor ke mutaabiq kuch kharcha dena, yeh muttaqi logon ki zimmedaari hai
Isi tarah Parwardigar apni aayaat ko bayaan karta hai ke shaayad tumhein aql aa jaaye

Kya tum ne un logon ko nahin dekha jo hazaaron ki ta'daad mein apne gharon se nikal pade maut ke khauf se, aur Khuda ne inhein maut ka hukm de diya aur phir zinda kar diya, ke Khuda logon par bahut fazl karne waala hai, lekin aksar log shukriya nahin ada karte hain
Aur raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad karo aur yaad rakho ke Khuda sunne waala bhi hai aur jaanne waala bhi hai
Kaun hai jo Khuda ko qarz-e-hasan de aur phir Khuda use kai guna kar ke waapas kar de? Khuda kam bhi kar sakta hai aur ziyaada bhi, aur tum sab usi ki baargaah mein paltaaye jaaoge

Kya tum ne Moosa ke baad Bani Israaeel ki us jamaa'at ko nahin dekha jis ne apne nabi se kaha ke hamaare waaste ek baadshaah muqarrar kijiye taake hum raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad karein? Nabi ne farmaaya ke andesha yeh hai ke tum par jihaad waajib ho jaaye to tum jihaad na karo. Un logon ne kaha ke hum kyon kar jihaad na karenge jab ke humein hamaare gharon aur baal bachchon se alag nikaal baahar kar diya gaya hai. Us ke baad jab jihaad waajib kar diya gaya to thode se afraad ke ilaawa sab munharif ho gaye, aur Allah zaalimeen ko khoob jaanta hai

Un ke paighambar ne kaha ke Allah ne tumhaare liye Taaloot ko haakim muqarrar kiya hai. Un logon ne kaha ke yeh kis tarah hukoomat karenge, un ke paas to maal ki faraawaani nahin hai, un se ziyaada to hum hi haqdaar-e-hukoomat hain. Nabi ne jawaab diya ke inhein Allah ne tumhaare liye muntakhab kiya hai aur ilm o jism mein wus'at ata farmaayi hai, aur Allah jise chaahta hai apna mulk de deta hai, ke woh saahib-e-wus'at bhi hai aur saahib-e-ilm bhi

Aur un ke paighambar ne yeh bhi kaha ke un ki hukoomat ki nishaani yeh hai ke yeh tumhaare paas woh Taaboot le aayenge jis mein Parwardigar ki taraf se saamaan-e-sukoon aur Aal-e-Moosa aur Aal-e-Haaroon ka chhoda hua tarka bhi hai. Us Taaboot ko malaaika uthaaye hue honge, aur is mein tumhaare liye qudrat-e-Parwardigar ki nishaani bhi hai agar tum saahib-e-imaan ho

Us ke baad jab Taaloot lashkar le kar chale to unhon ne kaha ke ab Khuda ek nahar ke zariye tumhaara imtehaan lene waala hai. Jo us mein se pi lega woh mujh se na hoga aur jo na chakhega woh mujh se hoga, magar yeh ke ek chullu paani le le. Nateeja yeh hua ke sab ne paani pi liya siwaaye chand afraad ke. Phir jab woh saahibaan-e-imaan ko le kar aage badhe to logon ne kaha ke aaj to Jaaloot aur us ke lashkaron ke muqaable ki himmat nahin hai, aur ek jamaa'at ne jise Khuda se mulaaqaat karne ka khayaal tha kaha ke aksar chhote chhote giroh badi badi jamaa'aton par hukm-e-Khuda se ghaalib aa jaate hain, aur Allah sabr karne waalon ke saath hai

Aur yeh log jab Jaaloot aur us ke lashkaron ke muqaable ke liye nikle to unhon ne kaha ke Khudaya! Humein be-panaah sabr ata farma, hamaare qadmon ko sabaat de aur humein kaafiron ke muqaable mein nusrat ata farma

Nateeja yeh hua ke un logon ne Jaaloot ke lashkar ko Khuda ke hukm se shikast de di, aur Daawood ne Jaaloot ko qatl kar diya, aur Allah ne inhein mulk aur hikmat ata kar di aur apne ilm se jis qadr chaaha de diya. Aur agar isi tarah Khuda ba'z ko ba'z se na rokta rehta to saari zameen mein fasaad phail jaata, lekin Khuda aalameen par bada fazl karne waala hai
Yeh aayaat-e-Ilaahiya hain jin ko hum waaqe'iyat ke saath aap ko padh kar sunaate hain, aur aap yaqeenan mursaleen mein se hain

Yeh sab rasool woh hain jinhein hum ne ba'z ko ba'z par fazeelat di hai. Un mein se ba'z woh hain jin se Khuda ne kalaam kiya hai aur ba'z ke darajaat buland kiye hain, aur hum ne Eesa ibn-e-Maryam ko khuli hui nishaaniyaan di hain aur Rooh-ul-Qudus ke zariye un ki taaeed ki hai. Agar Khuda chaahta to un rasoolon ke baad waale un waazeh mo'jizaat ke aa jaane ke baad aapas mein jhagda na karte, lekin un logon ne (Khuda ke jabr na karne ki bina par) ikhtilaaf kiya hai. Ba'z imaan laaye aur ba'z kaafir ho gaye, aur agar Khuda tai kar leta to yeh jhagda na kar sakte, lekin Khuda jo chaahta hai wahi karta hai

Ae imaan waalo! Jo tumhein rizq diya gaya hai us mein se raah-e-Khuda mein kharch karo qabl is ke ke woh din aa jaaye jis din na tijaarat hogi, na dosti kaam aaegi aur na sifaarish, aur kaafireen hi asl mein zaalimeen hain

Allah jis ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, zinda bhi hai aur usi se kul kaainaat qaaim hai. Use na neend aati hai na oongh. Aasmaanon aur zameen mein jo kuch bhi hai sab usi ka hai. Kaun hai jo us ki baargaah mein us ki ijaazat ke baghair sifaarish kar sake? Woh jo kuch un ke saamne hai aur jo pas-e-pusht hai sab ko jaanta hai, aur yeh us ke ilm ke ek hisse ka bhi ihaata nahin kar sakte magar woh jis qadr chaahe. Us ki Kursi-e-ilm o iqtidaar zameen o aasmaan se wasee'-tar hai, aur use un ke tahaffuz mein koi takleef bhi nahin hoti. Woh aali-martaba bhi hai aur saahib-e-azmat bhi

Deen mein kisi tarah ka jabr nahin hai. Hidaayat gumraahi se alag aur waazeh ho chuki hai. Ab jo shakhs bhi Taaghoot ka inkaar kar ke Allah par imaan le aaye woh us ki mazboot rassi se mutamassik ho gaya hai jis ke tootne ka imkaan nahin hai, aur Khuda Samee' bhi hai aur Aleem bhi hai

Allah saahibaan-e-imaan ka waali hai, woh inhein taareekiyon se nikaal kar raushni mein le aata hai, aur kuffaar ke waali Taaghoot hain jo inhein raushni se nikaal kar andheron mein le jaate hain. Yahi log Jahannami hain aur wahaan hamesha rehne waale hain

Kya tum ne us ke haal par nazar nahin ki jis ne Ibraheem se Parwardigar ke baare mein behs ki sirf is baat par ke Khuda ne use mulk de diya tha? Jab Ibraheem ne yeh kaha ke mera Khuda jilaata bhi hai aur maarta bhi hai, to us ne kaha ke yeh kaam main bhi kar sakta hoon. To Ibraheem ne kaha ke mera Khuda mashriq se aaftaab nikaalta hai, tu maghrib se nikaal de. To kaafir hairaan reh gaya, aur Allah zaalim qaum ki hidaayat nahin karta hai

Ya us bande ki misaal jis ka guzar ek qarye se hua jis ke saare arsh o farsh gir chuke the, to us bande ne kaha ke Khuda in sab ko maut ke baad kis tarah zinda karega? To Khuda ne us bande ko sau saal ke liye maut de di aur phir zinda kiya, aur poochha ke kitni der pade rahe? To us ne kaha ke ek din ya kuch kam. Farmaaya nahin, sau saal. Zara apne khaane aur peene ko to dekho ke kharaab tak nahin hua, aur apne gadhe par nigaah karo (ke sad gal gaya hai), aur hum isi tarah tumhein logon ke liye ek nishaani banaana chaahte hain. Phir un haddiyon ko dekho ke hum kis tarah jod kar un par gosht chadhaate hain. Phir jab un par yeh baat waazeh ho gayi to be-saakhta aawaaz di ke mujhe maaloom hai ke Khuda har shai par qaadir hai

Aur us mauqe ko yaad karo jab Ibraheem ne iltija ki ke Parwardigar! Mujhe yeh dikha de ke tu murdon ko kis tarah zinda karta hai. Irshaad hua kya tumhaara imaan nahin hai? Arz ki imaan to hai lekin itminaan chaahta hoon. Irshaad hua ke chaar taair pakad lo aur inhein apne se maanoos banaao, phir tukde tukde kar ke har pahaad par ek hissa rakh do, aur phir aawaaz do, sab daudte hue aa jaayenge, aur yaad rakho ke Khuda saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi

Jo log raah-e-Khuda mein apne amwaal kharch karte hain un ke amal ki misaal us daane ki hai jis se saat baaliyaan paida hon aur phir har baali mein sau sau daane hon, aur Khuda jis ke liye chaahta hai izaafa bhi kar deta hai, ke woh saahib-e-wus'at bhi hai aur aleem o daana bhi
Jo log raah-e-Khuda mein apne amwaal kharch karte hain aur us ke baad ehsaan nahin jataate aur aziyyat bhi nahin dete, un ke liye Parwardigar ke yahaan ajr bhi hai aur na koi khauf hai na huzn
Nek kalaam aur maghfirat us sadqe se behtar hai jis ke peechhe dil dukhaane ka silsila bhi ho. Khuda sab se be-niyaaz aur bada burdbaar hai

Imaan waalo! Apne sadaqaat ko minnat-guzaari aur aziyyat se barbaad na karo, us shakhs ki tarah jo apne maal ko duniya dikhaane ke liye sarf karta hai aur us ka imaan na Khuda par hai aur na aakhirat par. Us ki misaal us saaf chataan ki hai jis par gard jam gayi ho ke tez baarish ke aate hi bilkul saaf ho jaaye. Yeh log apni kamaai par bhi ikhtiyaar nahin rakhte, aur Allah kaafiron ki hidaayat bhi nahin karta

Aur jo log apne amwaal ko razaa-e-Khuda ki talab aur apne nafs ke istehkaam ki gharaz se kharch karte hain un ke maal ki misaal us baagh ki hai jo kisi bulandi par ho aur tez baarish aa kar us ki fasal dugna bana de, aur agar tez baarish na aaye to ma'mooli baarish hi kaafi ho jaaye, aur Allah tumhaare aamaal ki niyyaton se khoob baakhabar hai

Kya tum mein se koi yeh pasand karta hai ke us ke paas khajoor aur angoor ke baagh hon, un ke neeche nahrein jaari hon, un mein har tarah ke phal hon, aur aadmi boodha ho jaaye, us ke kamzor bachche hon, aur phir achaanak tez garam hawa jis mein aag bhari ho chal jaaye aur sab jal kar khaak ho jaaye? Khuda isi tarah apni aayaat ko waazeh kar ke bayaan karta hai ke shaayad tum fikr kar sako

Ae imaan waalo! Apni paakeeza kamaai aur jo kuch hum ne zameen se tumhaare liye paida kiya hai sab mein se raah-e-Khuda mein kharch karo, aur khabardaar infaaq ke iraade se kharaab maal ko haath bhi na lagaana, ke agar yeh maal tum ko diya jaaye to aankh band kiye baghair chhooge bhi nahin. Yaad rakho ke Khuda sab se be-niyaaz hai aur sazaawaar-e-hamd o sana bhi hai
Shaitaan tum se faqeeri ka wa'da karta hai aur tumhein buraaiyon ka hukm deta hai, aur Khuda maghfirat aur fazl o ehsaan ka wa'da karta hai. Khuda saahib-e-wus'at bhi hai aur aleem o daana bhi
Woh jis ko bhi chaahta hai hikmat ata kar deta hai, aur jise hikmat ata kar di jaaye use goya khair-e-kaseer ata kar diya gaya, aur is baat ko saahibaan-e-aql ke ilaawa koi nahin samajhta hai
Aur tum jo kuch bhi raah-e-Khuda mein kharch karoge ya nazr karoge to Khuda us se baakhabar hai, albatta zaalimeen ka koi madadgaar nahin hai

Agar tum sadqe ko ala-l-e'laan doge to yeh bhi theek hai, aur agar chhupa kar fuqara ke hawaale kar doge to yeh bhi bahut behtar hai, aur us ke zariye tumhaare bahut se gunaah maaf ho jaayenge, aur Khuda tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Ae Paighambar! Un ki hidaayat pa jaane ki zimmedaari aap par nahin hai balke Khuda jis ko chaahta hai hidaayat de deta hai. Aur logo! Jo maal bhi tum raah-e-Khuda mein kharch karoge woh dar-asl apne hi liye hoga, aur tum to sirf khushnoodi-e-Khuda ke liye kharch karte ho, aur jo kuch bhi kharch karoge woh poora poora tumhaari taraf waapas aaega aur tum par kisi tarah ka zulm na hoga

Yeh sadqa un fuqara ke liye hai jo raah-e-Khuda mein giraftaar ho gaye hain aur kisi taraf jaane ke qaabil bhi nahin hain. Naawaaqif afraad inhein un ki haya o iffat ki bina par maaldaar samajhte hain, haalaanke tum aasaar se un ki ghurbat ka andaaza kar sakte ho, agarche yeh logon se chimat kar sawaal nahin karte hain, aur tum log jo kuch bhi infaaq karoge Khuda use khoob jaanta hai
Jo log apne amwaal ko raah-e-Khuda mein raat mein, din mein, khaamoshi se aur ala-l-e'laan kharch karte hain, un ke liye pesh-e-Parwardigar ajr bhi hai aur inhein na koi khauf hoga aur na huzn

Jo log sood khaate hain woh roz-e-qiyaamat us shakhs ki tarah uthenge jise Shaitaan ne chhoo kar makhboot-ul-hawaas bana diya ho, is liye ke unhon ne yeh keh diya hai ke tijaarat bhi sood jaisi hai, jab ke Khuda ne tijaarat ko halaal qaraar diya hai aur sood ko haraam. Ab jis ke paas Khuda ki taraf se naseehat aa gayi aur us ne sood ko tark kar diya to guzishta kaarobaar ka mu'aamala Khuda ke hawaale hai, aur jo us ke baad bhi sood le to woh log sab Jahannami hain aur wahin hamesha rehne waale hain
Khuda sood ko barbaad kar deta hai aur sadaqaat mein izaafa kar deta hai, aur Khuda kisi bhi naashukre gunaahgaar ko dost nahin rakhta
Jo log imaan le aaye aur unhon ne nek amal kiye, namaaz qaaim ki, zakaat ada ki, un ke liye Parwardigar ke yahaan ajr hai, aur un ke liye kisi tarah ka khauf ya huzn nahin hai
Imaan waalo! Allah se daro aur jo sood baaqi reh gaya hai use chhod do agar tum saahibaan-e-imaan ho
Agar tum ne aisa na kiya to Khuda o Rasool se jang karne ke liye taiyaar ho jaao, aur agar tauba kar lo to asl maal tumhaara hi hai, na tum zulm karoge na tum par zulm kiya jaaega
Aur agar tumhaara maqrooz tang-dast hai to use wus'at-e-haal tak mohlat di jaaegi, aur agar tum maaf kar doge to tumhaare haq mein ziyaada behtar hai basharte ke tum use samajh sako
Us din se daro jab tum sab palta kar Allah ki baargaah mein le jaaye jaaoge, us ke baad har nafs ko us ke kiye ka poora poora badla milega aur kisi par koi zulm nahin kiya jaaega

Imaan waalo! Jab bhi aapas mein ek muqarrara muddat ke liye qarz ka len den karo to use likh lo, aur tumhaare darmiyaan koi bhi kaatib likhe lekin insaaf ke saath likhe, aur kaatib ko na chaahiye ke Khuda ki ta'leem ke mutaabiq likhne se inkaar kare, use likh dena chaahiye. Aur jis ke zimme qarz hai us ko chaahiye ke woh imla kare aur us Khuda se darta rahe jo us ka paalne waala hai aur kisi tarah ki kami na kare. Ab agar jis ke zimme qarz hai woh naadaan, kamzor ya mazmoon bataane ke qaabil nahin hai to us ka waali mazmoon taiyaar kare. Aur apne mardon mein se do ko gawaah banaao, aur do mard na hon to ek mard aur do auratein, taake ek behakne lage to doosri yaad dila de. Aur gawaahon ko chaahiye ke gawaahi ke liye bulaaye jaayein to inkaar na karein. Aur khabardaar likha padhi se naagawaari ka izhaar na karna, chaahe qarz chhota ho ya bada, muddat mu'ayyan honi chaahiye. Yahi Parwardigar ke nazdeek adaalat ke mutaabiq aur gawaahi ke liye ziyaada mustahkam tareeqa hai, aur is amr se qareeb-tar hai ke aapas mein shak o shubha na paida ho. Haan agar tijaarat naqd hai jis se tum log aapas mein amwaal ki ulat pher karte ho to na likhne mein koi harj bhi nahin hai, aur agar tijaarat mein bhi gawaah banaao to kaatib ya gawaah ko haq nahin ke apne tarz-e-amal se logon ko nuqsaan pahunchaaye, aur na logon ko yeh haq hai. Aur agar tum ne aisa kiya to yeh itaa'at-e-Khuda se naafarmaani (hogi)

Aur agar tum safar mein ho aur koi kaatib nahin mil raha hai to koi rehn rakh do, aur ek ko doosre par e'tebaar ho to jis par e'tebaar hai us ko chaahiye ke amaanat ko waapas kar de aur Khuda se darta rahe. Aur khabardaar gawaahi ko chhupaana nahin, ke jo aisa karega us ka dil gunaahgaar hoga, aur Allah tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki kul kaainaat hai. Tum apne dil ki baaton ka izhaar karo ya un par parda daalo, woh sab ka muhaasaba karega. Woh jis ko chaahega bakhsh dega aur jis par chaahega azaab karega, woh har shai par qudrat o ikhtiyaar rakhne waala hai

Rasool un tamaam baaton par imaan rakhta hai jo us ki taraf naazil ki gayi hain, aur momineen bhi sab Allah aur malaaika aur kutub aur mursaleen par imaan rakhte hain. Un ka kehna hai ke hum rasoolon ke darmiyaan tafreeq nahin karte. Hum ne paighaam-e-Ilaahi ko suna aur us ki itaa'at ki. Parwardigar! Ab teri maghfirat darkaar hai aur teri hi taraf palat kar aana hai

Allah kisi nafs ko us ki wus'at se ziyaada takleef nahin deta. Har nafs ke liye us ki haasil ki hui nekiyon ka faaida bhi hai aur us ki kamaai hui buraaiyon ka mazlama bhi. Parwardigar! Hum jo kuch bhool jaayein ya hum se ghalati ho jaaye us ka hum se muaakhaza na karna. Khudaya! Hum par waisa bojh na daalna jaisa pehle waali ummaton par daala gaya hai. Parwardigar! Hum par woh baar na daalna jis ki hum mein taaqat na ho. Humein maaf kar dena, humein bakhsh dena, hum par reham karna, tu hamaara Maula aur maalik hai, ab kaafiron ke muqaable mein hamaari madad farma
